emails:welcome.title: Welcome Email
emails:welcome.description: A green character-led welcome that names the workspace, explains the first three useful actions, and ends with one route back to the product.

emails:verify-email.title: Verify Email
emails:verify-email.description: A purple security message with a readable verification code, matching confirmation action, expiry, and a plain no-action-needed fallback.

emails:password-reset.title: Password Reset
emails:password-reset.description: A focused password-reset message with request context, expiry, one protected action, and guidance for an unrecognized request.

emails:workspace-invitation.title: Workspace Invitation
emails:workspace-invitation.description: A pink people-led invitation that identifies the inviter, workspace, role, expiry, and single join action.

emails:weekly-digest.title: Weekly Digest
emails:weekly-digest.description: A yellow orientation email that keeps only the decisions most likely to block next week, with owners, state, and one queue action.

emails:comment-mention.title: Comment Mention
emails:comment-mention.description: A pink collaboration notification that preserves the quoted question, its brief context, and one reply route.

emails:order-receipt.title: Order Receipt
emails:order-receipt.description: A complete receipt with order facts, readable line items, shipping, total, fulfillment expectation, and one order route.

emails:incident-update.title: Incident Update
emails:incident-update.description: A red system message that leads with current status, names the affected area, keeps a timestamped update trail, and links to live status.
